title: Jude and the Letters
author: Elodie Delacroix
blurb: Edmund Yarrow, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
